description: Team Harness deterministic-deny safety hooks for POSIX Codex. Native Codex permissions own approval prompts; review/trust is required before these hooks are active.

hooks.command: plugin_root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; hook_runner=""; case "$plugin_root" in /*) case "$plugin_root" in /|*/../*|*/./*|*/..|*/.) ;; *) direct_runner="$plugin_root/hooks/run-codex-hook.sh"; [ -f "$direct_runner" ] && [ ! -L "$direct_runner" ] && hook_runner="$direct_runner";; esac;; esac; if [ -z "$hook_runner" ]; then case "$plugin_root" in /*/plugins/cache/team-harness/team-harness/*) cache_parent="${plugin_root%/*}"; case "$cache_parent" in /*/plugins/cache/team-harness/team-harness) if [ -d "$cache_parent" ] && [ ! -L "$cache_parent" ]; then best_runner=""; for candidate_runner in "$cache_parent"/*/hooks/run-codex-hook.sh; do candidate_hooks="${candidate_runner%/*}"; candidate_root="${candidate_hooks%/*}"; candidate_manifest="$candidate_root/.codex-plugin/plugin.json"; [ -d "$candidate_root" ] && [ ! -L "$candidate_root" ] || continue; [ -d "$candidate_hooks" ] && [ ! -L "$candidate_hooks" ] || continue; [ -f "$candidate_runner" ] && [ ! -L "$candidate_runner" ] || continue; [ -f "$candidate_manifest" ] && [ ! -L "$candidate_manifest" ] || continue; candidate_version="${candidate_root##*/}"; node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=process.argv[1],v=process.argv[2];try{const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8"));process.exit(d.name==="team-harness"&&d.version===v?0:1)}catch{process.exit(1)}' "$candidate_manifest" "$candidate_version" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; if [ -z "$best_runner" ] || [ "$candidate_runner" -nt "$best_runner" ]; then best_runner="$candidate_runner"; fi; done; hook_runner="$best_runner"; fi;; esac;; esac; fi; if [ -z "$hook_runner" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked by team-harness Codex hook adapter: plugin runtime missing"}}'; exit 0; fi; exec bash "$hook_runner" policy-block
